capabilities: Generate text from selected text using prompt templates
Answer questions from a knowledge base
Run multi-round conversations between horizontal line markers
Show the prompt and token usage of the last chat
extras: On first run the plugin creates an Aizhipu folder with Chinese and English prompt templates. Zhipu API usage is billed by Zhipu, and generating images from text consumes a large number of tokens.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send note text to an AI model and bring generated results back into the note.
summary: Obsidian plugin that sends selected text to the Zhipu AI API with prompt templates to generate text, create images, and answer questions.
